decision: These are the exact original Tower/Podium assets of two adjacent separately attributed permit families. The K28/80 podium is an exposed source contributor, so its coverage is assessed with its exact same-GeoRef tower, not by filling its source hole. The only remaining foreign projection strip is the fully identified adjacent K42/90 podium boundary. Complete original geometry and current vectors show that strip at their shared model boundary; it is not an alternate source identity. All774current forms and the raw spatial/intersection negatives remain. This source identity interpretation grants no collision, terrain, support, legal ownership, placement or publication exception.

officialModelSubtypeSpec.meaning: Building Model ID subtype at characters 12–13: 01 Tower, 02 Podium. Source GeoRef is characters 2–11. No building geometry or physical acceptance inferred.
